global_task_scope: All 2,185,424 original q8,r5..8 tasks over all 546,356 eleven-vertex Ramsey(4,4) cores
proposed_mechanism: Nonnegative counts of all 2048 external core signatures, all mixed monochromatic-core-clique common-neighborhood Ramsey capacities (including the known core occupants), and individual signature multiplicity capacities
exclusion_gate: A checked capacity upper bound below 32 would exclude all four original q8 tasks for the corresponding core. First establish whether this entire linear mechanism can reach that threshold, before any catalog-wide LP computation.
failure_gate: A universal feasible fractional signature count of mass32 for every valid core establishes zero possible original-task exclusions by this exact mechanism; then checkpoint and yield without adding neighboring constraints or an integer backend.
